This is sand leveling, or topdressing. It creates a more level surface for your lawn by filling in low areas. I use masonry sand since I have Bermuda grass. If you have a cool season grass type, a screened topsoil may be better. I like to put a little fertilizer down prior to, and after to ensure bermuda is growing aggressively through the sand. 21 hours in 90 seconds👨🏽‍🌾 ⚠️Flash Warning⚠️ This house was bought near the end of 2025 and the garden was a right state!  I was called in to replace the fence panels and totally rip out the garden  (not the posts, they are a bit crooked but they are still standing😅)  I started with the fence panels, then began to totally clear the area of weeds and any other debris in the garden.  We added 2 railway sleepers at the back for a little flower bed. Then a thick layer of top soil was spread and we rolled out the turf. Then we moved 4 tonnes of hardcore to the back through the house!  Backbreaking stuff.  Thanks to my pal @Wagwarn Abel for jumping on and giving me a hand 🙏 This is obviously unfinished but I think the owner was going to slab the rest himself, so our job is done here for now! As always I wanna know what would YOU do now? There's a bed at the back that's totally empty!  I read and appreciate any comments and genuinely like reading your suggestions🙏 Thanks so much for watching anyway, follow if you haven't already for more vids like this!! 💧🌿 The Backyard Water Feature That Feels Like a Luxury Spa 🌿💧 This circular rain curtain fountain is one of the most calming and visually stunning backyard ideas you can add to an outdoor space. ✨ Modern. Peaceful. Architectural. It turns an ordinary garden into a relaxing sanctuary.  💦 Why This Design Is So Mesmerizing The flowing water creates: ✔️ Continuous soothing sound ✔️ Cooling effect in hot weather ✔️ Movement and reflection ✔️ A dramatic focal point ✔️ Instant spa-like atmosphere The circular shape makes it feel artistic and futuristic while still blending beautifully with nature.  🪵 The Warm Wood + Water Combination The natural wood tones soften the sleek modern design and make the feature feel organic instead of industrial. Paired with: 🌿 Tropical plants 🪨 Black river stones 🌱 Layered greenery 💧 Reflective water surfaces …it creates a luxurious resort vibe right at home.  🧘 A Space Designed for Relaxation Imagine sitting nearby with: ☕ Morning coffee 📖 A book 🎶 Soft music 🌙 Evening lighting 🌧️ The sound of falling water This is the kind of feature that lowers stress the moment you walk outside.  ✨ Why Water Features Transform Gardens Water adds: 💧 Sound 💧 Motion 💧 Reflection 💧 Cooling energy 💧 Wildlife attraction Even small backyard spaces feel larger and more peaceful when water is incorporated thoughtfully.  🌿 Perfect for Modern Landscape Design This feature fits beautifully into: ✔️ Minimalist gardens ✔️ Zen landscapes ✔️ Contemporary patios ✔️ Tropical backyard themes ✔️ Luxury outdoor living spaces It works especially well with wood decking, gravel, stone, and layered greenery.  🛠️ Could This Be DIY? A simplified version absolutely could be. Typical components include: 🔧 Curved metal or wood frame 🔧 Hidden water reservoir 🔧 Recirculating pump 🔧 Fine-drip irrigation tubing or perforated piping 🔧 Drainage stones and waterproof basin The key is smooth water distribution for the “rain curtain” effect.  🌙 Imagine It at Night… Add: ✨ Warm LED uplighting 💡 Hidden strip lights 🔥 Fire bowls nearby 🪴 Accent plants 🌌 Ambient seating …and this becomes an unforgettable nighttime retreat.  🏡 Outdoor Luxury Isn’t Always Huge Sometimes one beautiful centerpiece changes the entire feeling of a backyard. A thoughtfully designed water feature can make even a modest garden feel: 🌿 Elegant 🌿 Peaceful 🌿 High-end 🌿 Restorative  💬 Would You Add This to Your Backyard? 👇 Tell us: 💧 Would you prefer this with lights or natural only? 🌿 Modern minimalist or lush tropical style? 🪵 Wood finish or black metal frame? ☕ Would this be your morning coffee spot or evening relaxation zone?

Ornamental grasses do particularly well in the Northeast because many varieties are naturally adapted to cold winters, seasonal changes, and a wide range of soil conditions. Their deep, extensive root systems help them tolerate periods of summer heat and drought once established, while their dormant crowns allow them to survive freezing temperatures and return reliably each spring. Many grasses also thrive in the Northeast’s full sun and well-drained soils and require relatively little maintenance compared with many flowering plants. Their ability to handle both the cold winters and humid summers makes them a dependable choice for Northeast landscapes, while their movement, texture, and winter interest add structure to the landscape year-round.#Westchester#westchestercounty #planting #landscapedesign #Greenwich
